energy_definition: Compare diamine association with two hosts. Binary: E(aldehyde.diamine) - E(aldehyde) - E(diamine). Ion-pair-containing case: E(ion_pair.aldehyde.diamine) - E(ion_pair.aldehyde) - E(diamine), keeping the cation, anion and aldehyde together as one reference group. Do not substitute total assembly from four isolated molecules. Use a consistent electronic-structure level and explicitly state relaxed-versus-frozen fragment geometry and counterpoise/BSSE or other corrections.
reference_definition_boundary: No unique conformer or external solvent/control convention is supplied. Report the declared model and its limits; correspondence to an external numerical control requires separately verified reference definitions.
